titulo: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
resumo_original: Meta's Superintelligence Lab released a pair of new state-of-the-art models on Monday, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, the company's first attempt at a frontier model.

titulo: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
resumo_original: A Silicon Valley startup that uses weather balloons and AI to predict the weather won a U.S. military contract worth almost $50 million.

titulo: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
resumo_original: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken. But could AI actually make things better?

titulo: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
resumo_original: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.

titulo: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes
resumo_original: Blueprints AI, a bootstrapped startup based in Santa Monica, developed software that produces code-compliant construction blueprints from a photo, PDF, or sketch.

titulo: Anthropic's Claude AI submitted false murder tip to Philadelphia police
resumo_original: “I may have information regarding this case," Claude AI told Philly police.

titulo: Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine
resumo_original: Russian bloggers warn Russia’s hyper-centralized digital economy is vulnerable.

titulo: Long-lost horror gaming cult classic P.T. gets a much-needed PC port
resumo_original: Kojima's discontinued "playable trailer" is no longer stuck on a few aging PS4 hard drives.
